difficulty_reason: In Situation labelled situation-shriek, for a morphism f : X -> Y of FTS_S and K a dualizing complex for Y, the lemma asserts that f^!K is a dualizing complex for X (statement lines 4707-4731). The question is local on X, so one may assume X and Y affine, in which case f factors as a closed immersion i followed by a chain of affine space projections (proof lines 4733-4740). Lemma labelled lemma-shriek-affine-line together with Dualizing Complexes, Lemma labelled dualizing-lemma-dualizing-polynomial-ring and induction show that p^!K is dualizing on A^n_Y for the projection p, and Dualizing Complexes, Lemma labelled dualizing-lemma-dualizing-quotient together with Lemmas labelled lemma-sheaf-with-exact-support-quasi-coherent and lemma-shriek-closed-immersion show that i^! transforms dualizing complexes into dualizing complexes (proof lines 4740-4750). Reducing the local statement to the two model cases of the affine line and a closed immersion, and then composing along the factorization, is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
